title: Integrate INS-0054 through INS-0057 into MAP guidance and release evidence
description: Operator-directed implementation of the bounded changes promoted in PROMO-0015 through PROMO-0018. Document remote-authority classifier failures without weakening policy; make new release checklists name the emergence mechanism while preserving legacy release evidence; document opt-in emergence capture for intentionally non-MAP work without importing it into governance; and add live-backend integration hygiene to design-port task guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Remote-authority documentation distinguishes sanctioned MAP CLI use from classifier approval, tells agents to report exact failure evidence instead of retrying blindly, and grants no exemption, workaround, or automatic retry of policy denials.

New release checklists name sentinel scan, Discovery Agent pass, or neither with a reason; release validation accepts that structured evidence, rejects incomplete structured evidence, and remains backward compatible with historical exact-checkbox records.

Emergence guidance explicitly permits lightweight Related task: NONE capture for reusable lessons from intentionally non-MAP work while stating that capture creates no task, claim, authority, or governance relationship.

Task-authoring guidance tells design-port tasks to verify the live data contract, prefer existing backend fields, choose rollout and runtime integration deliberately, and allow explicit operator-approved exceptions.
Focused release-gate tests and map_emergence.py validate pass, and a delivery note maps all four insights to the adopted or rejected implementation choices.
A different core agent independently reviews the substantive release-gate and guidance changes before approval or release.
